description: Defines classes MediaAlbumArt and VideoFrame for handling media data and video frame information within the Android namespace.

classes.name: MediaAlbumArt
classes.description: A class for loading and storing binary album art data from a file.

classes.name: VideoFrame
classes.description: A class representing a color video frame with pixel data and dimensions.

methods.name: MediaAlbumArt()
methods.description: Default constructor initializing size and data to zero.

methods.name: MediaAlbumArt(const char* url)
methods.description: Constructor that loads binary data from a file specified by URL.

methods.name: MediaAlbumArt(const MediaAlbumArt& copy)
methods.description: Copy constructor that duplicates the data from another MediaAlbumArt instance.

methods.name: VideoFrame()
methods.description: Default constructor initializing frame dimensions and data to zero.

methods.name: VideoFrame(const VideoFrame& copy)
methods.description: Copy constructor that duplicates the frame data and dimensions.

methods.name: ~VideoFrame()
methods.description: Destructor that frees allocated frame data.
